errors.internal: Aji ran into an internal error.
errors.setupUnknownEngine: That engine is not in the list.
errors.setupUnknownNetwork: That network is not in the list.
errors.setupImportFailed: That file is not a KataGo network.
errors.setupInvalidSource: A download source must be a web address starting with http:// or https://.

failure.downloadFailed: The download failed from every source. Check the network connection, or try another download source.
failure.checksumMismatch: Every source gave a damaged or altered file, so Aji did not use it.
failure.notEnoughSpace: There is not enough free disk space for this install.
failure.unpackFailed: A downloaded package could not be unpacked.
failure.missingLibrary: KataGo could not find a library it needs.
failure.gpuDriverTooOld: The graphics driver is too old for this backend. Updating the driver may fix this.
failure.gpuError: KataGo could not use the graphics card with this backend.
failure.outOfMemory: The graphics card ran out of memory.
failure.openclNoDevice: No graphics card could be used through OpenCL.
failure.licenceNotAccepted: This backend needs a licence that has not been accepted.
failure.timedOut: KataGo took too long to answer.
